summary: Completed frontend testing of FeGrro Hours Table rewrite. All requested features are working correctly. The Hours Table displays employees with neutral dark backgrounds, weekend columns with distinct reddish-brown color, assignment mode with site coloring, hours editing, per-site totals, Nieprzypisane column, and SUMA column.
passed_tests: Admin login works with admin@fegrro.pl / Admin123!
Hours Table loads at /admin/hours-table with 4 employees (Jan Kowalski, Anna Nowak, Piotr Wisniewski, Test Employee)
Name column (Pracownik) has neutral dark bg (#1E293B = rgb(30, 41, 59)) - NOT site colors
Weekend columns (sob, niedz) have visually distinct background (#3D2E2E = rgb(61, 46, 46))
Weekend day names displayed in reddish color (#E8836A = rgb(232, 131, 106))
In 'Edycja godzin' mode (default), clicking a cell opens input for hours
Input accepts numbers and closes on Escape
Clicking site button (SASINO/LEBA ERBUD/BAUHAUS/Test Budowa) activates assignment mode
In assignment mode, clicking cells colors them with that site's color from legend (SASINO = #3B4F5C)
Header shows count ('Zaznaczono: X') and 'Przypisz (X)' + 'Anuluj' buttons in assignment mode
Per-site hour columns show site-specific totals for each employee (SASINO, LEBA ERBUD, BAUHAUS, Test Budowa)
Nieprzypisane column shows hours not assigned to any site
SUMA column shows total of all hours (Jan Kowalski: 8, others: 0)
Legend at bottom shows weekend color (Sobota/Niedziela) and each site color
All backgrounds are dark - no light/beige/white anywhere
Mode buttons work correctly - 'Edycja godzin' and site buttons toggle modes
Error handling works - shows toast when trying to enter hours on unassigned cell

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Hours Table features from the rewrite are working correctly. Key implementation details: 1) Employee name cells use bg-[#1E293B] class. 2) Weekend cells use inline style backgroundColor: '#3D2E2E' with text color #E8836A. 3) Assignment mode uses SITE_COLORS_HEX array for coloring. 4) Hours can only be entered for today/yesterday (backend validation). 5) Per-site totals calculated via getEmployeeHoursBySite function.

hours_editing_mode.details: Clicking cell opens number input, Escape cancels

assignment_mode.details: Site buttons activate mode, cells get colored with site color
